architecture.web: @ten4seven/ui resolves the same contract to DOM/CSS projections.
architecture.native: @ten4seven/native resolves typed values and renders React Native primitives through a separate renderer.
architecture.invariant: one semantic language, one token source, multiple renderers; Native never parses CSS

maturity.reason: A real React Native renderer foundation and Expo Lab source exist; Android emulator/device and iOS runtime evidence are not available in this checkout environment.

renderer.values: resolved JS/TS theme snapshot; opaque sRGB colors, numeric dimensions, numeric durations

foundations.note: Text, Surface, Badge, semantic icon, typography, and theme primitives render through the native package.

layout.note: Flexbox composition, ScrollView, safe-area provider, runtime dimensions, and measure roles are implemented; device QA is pending.

actions.note: Pressable actions use shared intent, minimum touch target, pressed state, and accessibility state.

forms.note: TextInput, password, checkbox, radio, switch, and selector sheet foundations are implemented; keyboard/device QA is pending.

selection.note: Select uses a native modal sheet/list strategy rather than a Web popup.

dateTime.note: Native picker adapter boundary is defined; production picker integration is deferred to a capability adapter.

files.note: Document/image/camera source presentation is defined; no upload or production picker is bundled.

navigation.note: Tabs, bottom navigation, back/up, and list/detail composition are renderer responsibilities.

overlays.note: Modal/sheet foundations handle explicit close and system-back callbacks; native QA is pending.

feedback.note: Banner, status, progress, and toast composition use semantic status and reduced-motion intent.

data.note: FlatList is the native collection path; DataTable maps to record list/detail rather than a squeezed table.

charts.note: U08 chart semantics remain available; no chart engine is bundled in the native foundation.

maps.note: U08 map semantics remain an engine boundary; no map engine is bundled.

workflow.note: Work queue, decision workspace, wizard, and Kanban list/selector strategies remain consumer compositions.

aiPower.note: U10 conversation, composer, citation, tool, approval, and command presentation is available through native primitives.

profiles.note: Neutral, Farm, Operations, ERP, and Academy profiles resolve through the shared theme runtime; device rendering remains unverified.

deviceCapabilities.note: Capability state and adapter boundaries are modeled; platform API integration and device QA remain pending.

Select.proof: value, label, disabled, empty, selected state, long options, and accessible trigger

DataTable.nativePresentation: FlatList record list with detail/action path
DataTable.proof: record identity, primary fields, status, selection/action intent, and no squeezed table

MasterDetail.proof: list selection, detail context, direct entry, and return intent

Kanban.proof: movement remains intent-only; five lanes are not squeezed into a phone viewport

TooltipPopover.proof: important help remains available without hover

AIConversation.proof: long content, scroll-to-latest intent, citations, tool status, approval, and composer actions

EditorBuilder.proof: honor U10 Web classification; no forced desktop editor/builder parity

safeArea.presentation: Inset-aware shell, sticky actions, sheets, toast, and full-screen surfaces.
accessibility: Keep headings, content, and actions within the readable inset region.

virtualKeyboard.presentation: Focused fields and action rows remain reachable while the keyboard is visible.
accessibility: Keep the focused field labelled and the primary action reachable.

camera.presentation: Permission, launch, capture, retake, use-result, loading, and error states.
accessibility: Camera actions have labels and a non-camera path for important tasks.

qrScanner.presentation: Generic scanner frame with permission, ready, scanning, detected, invalid, success, error, and cancel states.
accessibility: Provide a labelled scan action and manual entry alternative.

documentPicker.presentation: Document-source action or native document picker entry.
accessibility: Document source actions expose labels, type, and result state.

photoLibrary.presentation: Image-library source action with permission and selected-media state.
accessibility: Image source and selected result expose accessible labels.

permissions.presentation: Why-needed, denied, settings, retry, and granted presentation.
accessibility: Explain the capability and make retry/settings actions reachable.

location.primitive: expo-location adapter behind location state contract
location.presentation: Unavailable, permission, locating, found, error, and cancel states.
accessibility: Location state and retry action are announced as text.

haptics.presentation: Optional selection, confirmation, warning, or impact feedback intent.
accessibility: Haptics never replace visual or accessible status feedback.

pushEntry.presentation: Destination loading, context restoration, expired target, and error state.
accessibility: Restored destination and invalid-target meaning are readable.

deepLink.presentation: Direct-entry composition for detail, task, product, or notification context.
accessibility: Direct entry has a meaningful title, context, and back/up action.

offline.presentation: Banner, status, row, work-context, and sticky-action connectivity state.
accessibility: Connectivity meaning is text-readable and not color-only.

sync.presentation: Pending, syncing, synced, failed, retry, and conflict presentation.
accessibility: Sync state is bounded status text with an explicit retry action.

networkRetry.presentation: Retry, waiting, failed, and queued action states.
accessibility: Retry status and action are exposed without live-region spam.
Do not reveal secret values in labels, logs, or fixtures.
Background status has an explicit readable state.

orientation.presentation: Portrait, landscape, and available-space adaptive layout.
accessibility: Orientation changes preserve reading order and focus.

fontScale.presentation: Larger text without clipping, overlap, or fixed-height truncation.
accessibility: Do not globally disable user font scaling.

offlineSync.ownership: presentation-only; consumer owns the sync engine and retry execution

nativeLab.role: deterministic Native Component Lab, not a product application
nativeLab.fixtureData: synthetic and domain-neutral; no API, auth backend, persistence, upload, or business mutation

rendererExtensions.nativeProps: platform accessibility, safe-area, press, keyboard, and native-picker extensions
rendererExtensions.compatibility: preserve valid Web API; add renderer extension instead of deleting Web capability

dependencyPolicy.adapterRule: capability or engine is added only behind the shared contract after license, Expo compatibility, accessibility, and performance review

deferred: Android/iOS device runtime QA where this Windows checkout has no attached emulator/device and no iOS simulator.
Expo custom development-client capability integration for camera, scanner, location, push, secure storage, and background tasks.
Production navigation/router, offline database, sync engine, conflict resolver, secure storage, authentication, push registration, and deep-link parsing.
Chart/map/editor/DnD engines and virtualization beyond the native foundation primitives.
VoiceOver/TalkBack runtime certification and physical-device font-scale/haptics verification.
